info.prompt: A neon-drenched cyber cathedral where gravity flips manifest as cascading golden arches—each 90° rotation sends dice sliding across ribcage-etched tiles in 400ms physics bursts, their trajectories marked by ghostly cyan slipstream trails while leaders shimmer with heat distortion under skeletal UI frames, the entire scene backlit by throbbing neural filaments that pulse to the rhythm of hidden terminal commands scrolling across void-black vaults.
